description: This file contains utility functions for processing and sanitizing agent messages, particularly focusing on image content within messages, including functions to check message content, sanitize images, and handle message roles.

methods.name: isThinkingOrRedactedBlock
methods.description: Checks if a message block is of type 'thinking' or 'redacted_thinking'.

methods.name: isEmptyAssistantMessageContent
methods.description: Determines if an assistant message's content is empty or contains only whitespace text blocks.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionMessagesImages
methods.description: Sanitizes images within session messages, handling different message roles and optional signature preservation.
